tasks.title: Record the public-source investigation
tasks.description: Completed for this document: distinguish official documentation, provider claims, unverified integration and missing evidence. This is not an authenticated API test.
tasks.evidence: Inherited public-source audit only; no authenticated integration test.

tasks.title: Lock a single pilot market
tasks.description: Choose region, server or market group, faction where relevant, client build and language. TW is a candidate, not a fixed requirement. Never infer the game region from the player’s location.

tasks.title: Ask NC about an AION 2 market-data interface
tasks.description: Request documentation, supported regions, authentication, permitted use, refresh frequency and limits. Do not reuse Lineage 2M endpoints as if they belonged to AION 2.

tasks.title: Request a price-data partnership
tasks.description: Ask Aion2t about programmatic access, source methodology, timestamps, market coverage, rates, cost, storage and redistribution rights. A consumer Premium account is not the same as an API/data licence.

tasks.title: Validate a representative price sample
tasks.description: Obtain at least 20 items at two observation times, including raw materials, intermediates and finished goods. Compare with the same in-game market and item variant. Log gaps, delays and discrepancies.

tasks.title: Confirm the overlay route
tasks.description: Check the exact AION 2 regional client in Overwolf’s Native / Electron support directory and test it. Clarify app approval and publishing requirements; keep a normal desktop-window route independent.

tasks.title: Define item and market identities
tasks.description: Use stable item IDs plus region/build, quality, enhancement and other sale-relevant variants. Price keys must also include market scope and source currency. Localized names are search aliases, not primary keys.
tasks.evidence: aioncrafter/identity.py; tests/test_identity.py (8 tests). Exact scoped keys, unknown-scope blocking and strict round-trip.

tasks.title: Obtain and import a permitted catalog
tasks.description: Pilot target: at least 100 relevant items and 25 verified recipes. Confirm rights for data, icons and redistribution; a public repository or webpage alone is not a reuse licence.
tasks.evidence: Real pilot scope and permitted catalog unresolved; 7 SYNTHETIC variants / 3 SYNTHETIC recipes do not satisfy 100 relevant real items / 25 verified recipes.

tasks.title: Model complete crafting outcomes
tasks.description: Store inputs, quantities, batch yield, crafting fee, requirements and possible outputs. Attach source/build metadata; leave unknown probabilities explicitly unknown.
tasks.evidence: aioncrafter/models.py; tests/test_models.py; 3 synthetic recipes exercise batches, joint outcomes/failure, fees and unknown probabilities.

tasks.title: Model tradability and acquisition constraints
tasks.description: Represent bound/unbound variants, vendor restrictions, quantity limits and currency types. A vendor sell-back value is not an auction purchase price; incompatible currencies are not silently added.
tasks.evidence: aioncrafter/identity.py and models.py; tests/test_models.py. Bound/tradeable variants, vendor limits/currencies, sell-back distinction.

tasks.title: Validate imports before publishing
tasks.description: Reject orphan IDs, impossible quantities, duplicate identities, cycles and ambiguous aliases. Review changes after each patch and preserve the last known-good catalog.
tasks.evidence: aioncrafter/catalog.py; tests/test_catalog.py and test_storage.py. Strict import, orphan/duplicate/alias/cycle rejection; invalid import preserves last known-good.

tasks.title: Create storage and provider contracts
tasks.description: Start with SQLite and migrations. Define Item, Recipe, MarketScope, PriceObservation and Calculation records. Use exact arithmetic for money and explicit nulls for missing prices.
tasks.evidence: aioncrafter/storage.py and providers.py; tests/test_storage.py and test_cli.py. SQLite migrations 1->2, immutable history, concurrency check, rollback and offline CLI.

tasks.title: Implement item → materials → margin
tasks.description: Search a product, select its recipe and quantity, show direct ingredients or a fully expanded tree, price the output and calculate estimated profit/loss.
tasks.evidence: web.py; bilingual alias search, direct ingredients/batches/margins; full-form HTTP calculation+save passed. Visual QA deferred; real-game pilot after all phase feature work; recursion Phase 04. Owner confirmed calculator behaviour correct on 2026-10-04; behaviour acceptance complete.

tasks.title: Implement materials-only pricing
tasks.description: Accept selected items or a pasted materials list. Resolve ambiguous names with a picker. Return unit prices, quantities, subtotals and a total without requiring a recipe or a selling-price field.
tasks.evidence: web.py; selected/pasted quantities and ambiguity picker; full-form HTTP total/missing-price/owned-cash cases passed. Visual QA deferred; real-game pilot after all phase feature work. Owner confirmed calculator behaviour correct on 2026-10-04; behaviour acceptance complete.

tasks.title: Add a source-aware price editor
tasks.description: Let users enter their own observed prices or approved reference imports. Require market and observation time; distinguish manual, vendor, snapshot, delayed and unavailable values.
tasks.evidence: references.py/web.py; offline manual/vendor/snapshot imports, per-field source/age, unknown times, exact observation preservation through repeated calculate/search/save; merged ID collision rejected. 6 reference tests + full-form HTTP cases. Visual QA deferred; real-game pilot after all phase feature work. Reference ID immutable replay, atomic invalid import, zero/unavailable, future/subsecond age coverage; 95 full-suite tests at d355f7107d0a2205a61afc672f7c27f9b2146864. Owner confirmed calculator behaviour correct on 2026-10-04; behaviour acceptance complete.

tasks.title: Separate cash needed from economic cost
tasks.description: Owned materials reduce the shopping list, not automatically the economic cost. Offer replacement-cost valuation, additional cash required and actual historical cost when the user supplies a ledger.
tasks.evidence: valuation.py/web.py; 6 valuation tests and form test. Replacement vs inventory-adjusted cash; allocated historical material cost requires complete records. Actual fee/sale ledger remains later scope; real-game pilot deferred until after all phase feature work. Owner confirmed calculator behaviour correct on 2026-10-04; behaviour acceptance complete.

tasks.title: Implement fees, yield and missing-price states
tasks.description: Calculate batch cost, net sale proceeds, profit, ROI and break-even price. Tax and fees are configurable and unverified until checked for the selected market. Never treat missing prices as zero.
tasks.evidence: economics.py; 11 tests including joint-output fee bases, multiple fees, negative net proceeds and exact break-even. Configurable game-unverified assumptions; real-game validation deferred until the final pilot. Owner confirmed calculator behaviour correct on 2026-10-04; behaviour acceptance complete.

tasks.title: Save plans and material lists
tasks.description: Persist favorites, market settings, user-entered prices and inventory quantities. Add JSON/CSV import/export with validation and a clear reset. No trading or crafting automation.
tasks.evidence: plans.py/web.py; v2 migration preserves payloads, monotonic counters reject stale save/delete after recreation. 9 plan tests and 4 full-form HTTP acceptance tests; JSON/CSV preserves displayed observations. Visual QA deferred. Owner confirmed calculator behaviour correct on 2026-10-04; behaviour acceptance complete.

tasks.title: Implement the approved provider adapter
tasks.description: Only after permission and a working sample: add an official or contracted community adapter behind the same interface as manual prices. Keep credentials on the backend.
tasks.evidence: ADR 0006: blocked on external provider/market evidence. Gate A UNVERIFIED; synthetic preparation does not satisfy real integration or release.

tasks.title: Preserve observation time and cache age
tasks.description: Record source-observed time, fetch time, price type and scope separately. A cache refresh must never make an old observation appear new. Unknown source time means freshness unknown.
tasks.evidence: price_cache.py; 11 synthetic tests for TTL versus source age, unknown/zero/unavailable, immutable replay, scope/variant/provider isolation and atomic invalid refresh. No real-provider or UI integration.

tasks.title: Respect quotas and degrade predictably
tasks.description: Batch permitted requests, use provider limits, backoff on throttling and stop retry storms. Show stale/error states and allow manual overrides without silently hiding their origin.
tasks.evidence: ADR 0006: independent synthetic groundwork selected next; no implementation claimed.

tasks.title: Use prices suitable for the requested quantity
tasks.description: When supported, consume listing depth or whole-stack offers to calculate the cost of buying all required units. With only a reference/minimum price, label the total indicative and stock unverified.
tasks.evidence: ADR 0006: independent synthetic groundwork selected next; no implementation claimed.

tasks.title: Run market reconciliation tests
tasks.description: Check 20 representative items across two snapshots, multiple variants and scope changes. Test wrong-region joins, zero listings, partial coverage and listed-versus-sold price distinctions.
tasks.evidence: ADR 0006: blocked on external provider/market evidence. Gate A UNVERIFIED; synthetic preparation does not satisfy real integration or release.

tasks.title: Approve the automatic-price feature
tasks.description: Enable it only for validated markets. Display age, source and missing-item count on every result. Do not describe snapshots as real time without evidence of their update behavior.
tasks.evidence: ADR 0006: blocked on external provider/market evidence. Gate A UNVERIFIED; synthetic preparation does not satisfy real integration or release.

tasks.title: Handle recursive yields and leftovers
tasks.description: Round craft counts upward by output yield, merge shared ingredients, carry leftovers and detect recipe cycles. Treat expected stochastic yields differently from guaranteed outputs.

tasks.title: Compare buying against crafting
tasks.description: Evaluate intermediate components at the requested quantity, including batch fees and leftovers. Respect recipe requirements, bound inputs and available market stock.

tasks.title: Model success, failure and proc outcomes
tasks.description: Use verified probabilities per recipe/build; distinguish alternative outputs from bonus outputs. Report expected revenue and downside scenarios instead of promising a guaranteed return.

tasks.title: Show market uncertainty
tasks.description: Keep asking prices separate from completed sales. Display stock and volume only when the provider supplies them. Do not infer liquidity or sell-through from a single cheap listing.

tasks.title: Rank crafts by usable economics
tasks.description: Filter by profession, budget, tradability and price completeness. Show estimated profit, capital required, ROI and data age; exclude incomplete or stale results from confident recommendations.

tasks.title: Compare estimates with actual outcomes
tasks.description: Optionally record user-entered purchase costs, crafting results, sale proceeds and fees. A finished item alone cannot reveal the player’s historical profit.

tasks.title: Select and validate the production shell
tasks.description: Choose an approved Overwolf Native/Electron route after support checks. Keep the calculator reusable in a browser or standard desktop window when platform support is absent.
tasks.evidence: User priority decision 2026-10-04: manual edition first; integration deferred until its gate is evidenced. See docs/decisions/0003-manual-first-development.md.

tasks.title: Build the compact companion view
tasks.description: Reuse item search, a pinned material list and margin summary. Keep market, source and age visible even in compact mode. Avoid covering essential game controls.
tasks.evidence: User priority decision 2026-10-04: manual edition first; integration deferred until its gate is evidenced. See docs/decisions/0003-manual-first-development.md.

tasks.title: Add deliberate focus and visibility controls
tasks.description: Provide a configurable show/hide hotkey, clear close control and a visible interaction mode. Test focus restoration; do not send automated commands to the game.
tasks.evidence: User priority decision 2026-10-04: manual edition first; integration deferred until its gate is evidenced. See docs/decisions/0003-manual-first-development.md.

tasks.title: Validate the desktop-window fallback
tasks.description: Test an always-on-top window with borderless/windowed mode; do not claim exclusive-fullscreen compatibility without tests. The browser/second-screen mode remains available.
tasks.evidence: User priority decision 2026-10-04: manual edition first; integration deferred until its gate is evidenced. See docs/decisions/0003-manual-first-development.md.

tasks.title: Keep the default integration minimal
tasks.description: No custom DLL injection, memory reading, packet capture, credential collection or automated trading. Optional screenshot import is a later, user-triggered feature—not an MVP dependency.
tasks.evidence: User priority decision 2026-10-04: manual edition first; integration deferred until its gate is evidenced. See docs/decisions/0003-manual-first-development.md.

tasks.title: Test supported display and performance setups
tasks.description: Check 1080p/1440p, DPI scaling, multiple monitors, hotkey collisions and coexistence with other overlays. Record idle CPU, memory and frame-time impact on declared hardware.
tasks.evidence: User priority decision 2026-10-04: manual edition first; integration deferred until its gate is evidenced. See docs/decisions/0003-manual-first-development.md.

tasks.title: Pass the calculation regression suite
tasks.description: Cover multi-output recipes, batch rounding, shared ingredients, fees, missing/zero values, unknown proc rates and non-tradable outputs. Verify exact monetary rounding.

tasks.title: Complete both workflows with pilot users
tasks.description: Use 20 real cases in one declared market. Verify materials, quantity, source age, listing interpretation and fee assumptions against the game; document unresolved discrepancies.

tasks.title: Make patch and outage handling recoverable
tasks.description: Version recipes, provider schemas and pricing rules. Add migration tests, provider health reporting and rollback to the last known-good data release.

tasks.title: Review secrets, privacy and input handling
tasks.description: Keep provider credentials server-side; minimize collected data. Validate imported files and API input, restrict desktop privileges and document retention/deletion behavior.

tasks.title: Publish installation and operating guidance
tasks.description: Include supported clients/markets, update procedure, known limitations, data attribution, licensing and non-affiliation notice. Sign desktop releases when applicable.

tasks.title: Run the release checklist and label the edition
tasks.description: Manual edition can ship without Gate A. Automatic-price and Overwolf editions require their respective gates plus quality checks. Archive the evidence supporting each public claim.
